How We Work  /  Pricing & Engagement

Three ways to work with us.

How engagements are shaped

Ad hoc

An hour or a day of our attention, for when you need a second opinion more than you need a project.

  • Sitting in on a vendor pitch and telling you afterward what you actually heard
  • Briefing a board on what AI will and will not do for a nonprofit
  • A one-day AI bootcamp for your staff

Hourly

Short term

A defined start, a defined finish, and a fixed price agreed before anyone starts working.

  • Reviewing your data ecosystem and writing up what to fix first
  • Automating a client intake workflow end to end
  • A migration or buildout, scoped and quoted up front

Project · flat fee

Long term

A standing arrangement with someone who already knows your setup and answers when you call.

  • Fractional CIO for an organization too small to hire one outright
  • Regular help desk support for your staff
  • A recurring advisory hour with whoever makes the decisions

Retainer · monthly

What it costs

Every engagement is quoted in writing before it starts, whichever shape it takes. Discounts for nonprofits and marginalized-owned businesses are built into that number, and public sector work follows the applicable schedule or solicitation.

We pride ourselves on working efficiently. The point is to solve the thing in front of you, not to run up hours — so tell us what you are dealing with on the first call, and we will tell you what it would run.

Access & discounts

We care what this costs you.

A discount for nonprofits and for businesses owned by marginalized people, incentives across Maine, and a limited number of pro bono hours. No application, no paperwork — you say so on the first call.

See what applies to you

How we handle the paperwork

Initial scoping on us

We invest the time up front to work out what you actually need, so that when you are ready to spend money with us, you spend it on the right thing.

No charge

Clear contracts and invoices

You know what you are signing and what you are paying for. Transparency is the point, not a courtesy.

In writing

Compliance is table stakes

We work with you to make sure what we deliver meets whatever compliance or funder requirements you answer to.

Built in

What every engagement includes

Notes you keep

Passwords, accounts, and what we changed — documented in plain language and handed to you.

One person

You talk to the person doing the work. No tiers, no tickets, no repeating your story.

No lock-in

Everything is in your name and under your control. If you leave, nothing has to be untangled.

Technology help for people, and their businesses, organizations, and communities.
